sentences.text: Kuntur was an extinct bird belonging to the family Cathartidae, which includes modern vultures.
The species Kuntur cardenasi was described by Stucchi and colleagues in 2015, based on only one fossil occurrence recorded in the Paleobiology Database.
This species lived in South America between 11.63 and 7.246 million years ago during the Tortonian stage of the Miocene epoch.
